content.title: MLB announces 2026 World Baseball Classic host sites: Houston, Miami and more
content.text: LoanDepot Park in Miami will host the finals of the sixth edition of the World Baseball Classic when the competition returns in March 2026, Major League Baseball announced Thursday.The three other venues for the tournament will be the Tokyo Dome in Japan, Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico, and Minute Maid Park in Houston. The semifinals will take place in Miami and Houston, which will host WBC games for the first time.The tournament has gained in popularity among American fans since debuting in 2006. Japan has won three of the five competitions, including a riveting, 3-2 victory over Team USA last spring that ended when Shohei Ohtani struck out his Angels teammate Mike Trout to seal the victory.The top four teams from each of the four pools in the 2023 tournament have already qualified for 2026. The final four spots will be filled in qualifiers to be held in 2025.Required reading What a World Baseball Classic ‘USA Dream Team’ could look like in 2026 World Baseball Classic ‘100 percent’ returning in 2026, MLB commissioner Rob Manfred says Ohtani, Japan hold off Team USA to capture 2023 World Baseball Classic title (Photo: Daniel Shirey / WBCI/MLB Photos via Getty Images)Mar 26, 2026Connections: Sports EditionSpot the pattern.
